purpose: Static transition storyboards for pre-code discovery; composition previews, not rendered animation

variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: static high-fidelity motion storyboard for the PRYDD website, used in a design discussion before application code.
Input image is a style and brand reference only: use its PRYDD symbol silhouette, exact PRYDD spelling, heavy geometric Montserrat-style uppercase typography, off-white backdrop, black text and electric blue actions. Do NOT reproduce its desktop/phone comparison layout.
Create a LANDSCAPE presentation board with FOUR equally sized desktop website frames in a neat 2-by-2 grid. Each frame depicts the same desktop viewport and fixed camera at successive moments of a scroll transition. No phone views, no tilted screens, no hardware mockups, no browser chrome. Light neutral gray board gutters, thin viewport borders, clear labels outside each frame. Label frames "01 / HERO", "02 / CONTRACT", "03 / REVEAL", "04 / SETTLE". Small top board title as specified below. Keep all website text readable. Do not add explanatory paragraphs.
The initial hero is a full-screen spherical shell of scattered small rectangular photos of diverse people and everyday places. Make it airy, with roughly 60% fewer photos than the supplied reference and generous gaps between tiles; this is a photographic globe, not a solid Earth or a map. No tiles cover the central headline. In the centre exact uppercase headline "ONE APP FOR EVERYDAY GLOBAL MONEY." split into sensible large lines. Supporting copy "Add money. Hold dollars. Send by username." One blue pill action with white "Join early access". Top left PRYDD symbol and "PRYDD", top right minimal "How it works". Preserve realistic photo colours and skin tones.
The motion principle comes from Revolut: the large hero scene itself contracts into a rounded card while the next white-background section emerges around it. Carry the SAME globe through the transition; do not substitute a new decorative object. Frame 02 shows a smaller centre hero card with more surrounding whitespace, rounding its corners, the same globe shrinking, headline fading. Frame 03 introduces the destination. Frame 04 shows a calm settled section ready for ordinary downward scrolling. This storyboard depicts proposed visual states; do not include rates, promises about transfer timing, fees, supported countries, spending cards, bank licensing or verified screenshots. Any dollar amounts and usernames are illustrative UI. Use clear geometry, strong hierarchy, generous spacing, soft restrained shadows, large rounded product panels and minimal labels. Keep the white and blue palette identical across all four frames and across the comparison concept.
Board title exact: "VARIANT 1 / THREE PRODUCT PANELS".
Frame 01: the globe hero described above.
Frame 02: that globe hero contracts into the centre rounded card, empty space growing around it.
Frame 03: the central card reveals a simple dollar-balance UI, with the smaller globe retained as a light background arc. Two companion cards start emerging from behind it, one to the left and one to the right. The fading old headline should no longer be competing with the product.
Frame 04: a short heading "Everyday money. One place." above three spacious rounded panels. LEFT panel titled "Add money" with a simple local-funding-to-USD visual and short "Local money → USD" label. CENTRE panel titled "Hold dollars" with one balance "$250.00" and two simple activity lines, a small subtle arc of the SAME photo globe remains in the background of this centre panel. RIGHT panel titled "Send by username" with "@maya", "$25.00" and small completion tick. The three panels look like one family. Show money entering, being held and being sent through visual objects, not paragraphs. These are three distinct product overview panels, not three phone devices.
Exact spelling PRYDD throughout. Do not add any other heading, caption or feature.
variants.targetedCopyCorrection:
Use case: ui-mockup. Input image is the precise edit target, the four-frame PRYDD storyboard "VARIANT 1 / THREE PRODUCT PANELS".
Make only these tiny product-copy corrections in BOTH lower frames 03 and 04: change activity label "From sarah" to exact "From @sarah"; change activity label "Coffee" to exact "To @leo"; change subtitle below the former Coffee row "Payment" to exact "Sent"; replace the green coffee-cup round icon on that activity row with a small green circle containing a white uppercase "L".
Preserve all amounts including +$50.00, -$4.50 and $250.00, other copy, all photographs, layout, palette, typography, logos, globe geometry, frame labels, headline and button content exactly. Do not add or remove any other content. The activity feed should clearly depict username payments in this conceptual design.
